amy_sales: Urgent unblock request from OrionScape CISO. They need EU data residency for the POC, a P95 latency SLO ~200ms during business hours, and a cap on monthly overage. Exec wants signoff within 24h. Can ENG + Pricing advise? cc @nina_eng @sam_se
sam_se: Do they insist on Private (on-prem/VPC) or will Hosted-EU with contractual DPA + KMS suffice? That changes provisioning time. Also need to know model use: chat vs embeddings/rerank.
nina_eng: Hosted-EU + dedicated pool should hit p95 ~200ms for typical chat workloads with 2x A100 equiv. Need prompt size distribution to be sure. If they require full private, provisioning is multi-week.
amy_sales: They said hosted-eu is OK for the trial but legal wants a signed data residency addendum and SOC2 evidence. I uploaded their security questionnaire to drive.
frank_revenue: Pricing note: we can offer a POC MSRP discount and a conversion path to Reserved capacity. To meet their cap request, propose a soft overage cap with a buffer and pre-funded burst credits. I'll draft numbers after ENG confirms baseline.
legal_triage_bot: legal-bot: SQ received. Assigned to @legal_ops. Requested DPA addendum and SLA exception template. ETA: 36 hours for first draft.
ops_bot: deploy-bot: Initiated eu-dedicated-provision request #DC-8022. Estimated provisioning 72h. Temporary hosted-EU guardrail ready.
sam_se: I'll start the SQ answers and confirm KMS in EU timeline. If legal needs technical attestations ping me.
amy_sales: Plan: present hosted-EU + guardrails + SOC2 + DPA for POC, start dedicated provisioning as fallback, revenue to draft conversion offer. I'll update after CISO confirms sample payload.
